# Aegis

Aegis is a local-first terminal firewall for AI coding agents. It turns an agent
action into a normalized request, applies a reviewable YAML policy, and produces an
explainable result: `allow`, `ask`, or `deny`.

The first MVP supports explicit action checks, JSONL inspection, a full-screen TUI,
and inspection of MCP `tools/call` messages. It never sends project data to an
external service.

## What works now

```powershell
# Evaluate one planned action.
cargo run -p aegis-cli -- check --kind file.read --target .env

# Inspect action requests generated by an agent integration.
cargo run -p aegis-cli -- inspect tests/fixtures/agent-requests.jsonl

# Inspect MCP tool calls without forwarding them to an upstream service.
cargo run -p aegis-cli -- mcp-inspect --input tests/fixtures/mcp-messages.jsonl

# Browse decisions in a terminal UI. Press q to exit.
cargo run -p aegis-cli -- tui --input tests/fixtures/agent-requests.jsonl
```

For automation, add `--json` to `check` or `inspect`.

## Policy format

Rules are evaluated from top to bottom. The first matching rule wins; otherwise
`default_action` applies. Every rule has an `id`, `effect`, and `action`. Target
patterns are selected by action:

| Action | Pattern property |
| --- | --- |
| `file.read`, `file.write` | `paths` |
| `process.execute` | `commands` |
| `network.connect` | `domains` |
| `mcp.call` | `tools` |

Use [`policies/default.yaml`](policies/default.yaml) as the starting policy.

## Repository layout

- `apps/aegis-cli`: command-line entry point and command parsing.
- `crates/aegis-core`: stable request, decision, and audit types.
- `crates/aegis-policy`: YAML loading, validation, glob matching, and evaluation.
- `crates/aegis-tui`: interactive decision browser.
- `crates/aegis-mcp-proxy`: MCP JSONL inspection adapter.
- `config`, `policies`, `docs`, `examples`: tracked configuration and documentation.
- `tests/fixtures`, `data`: safe, versioned test and sample data only.
- `secrets`, `var`, `tmp`, `dist`: local-only material ignored by Git.

## Local development

Install the current stable [Rust toolchain](https://www.rust-lang.org/tools/install), then run:

```powershell
cd C:\Users\nnine\Desktop\Aegis
rustup toolchain install stable
.\scripts\check.ps1
```

## Current security boundary

This MVP classifies and evaluates actions. The MCP command is an inspector: it
does not forward or execute tool calls. A production enforcement layer still needs
agent-specific hooks, process sandboxing, and a network proxy. Do not treat Aegis
as a replacement for secret isolation or human review of consequential actions.

See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) before reporting a vulnerability.
